question: Can synchronized color provide a threshold-free agreement signal that rejects the remaining SceneNN rank-only false matches without requiring partial geometric convex hulls to overlap?

independent_motivation.source_inference: Joint photometric-geometric evidence can constrain smooth or low-overlap geometry, and ColorPCR reports Hue as the more stable HSV component under color noise. Therefore an equal-status reciprocal agreement test is motivated independently of the consumed false-pair identities.

observation_carrier.source: unchanged 23 sealed synchronized SceneNN RGB-D frames and exact three-frame windows
observation_carrier.geometry: bitwise same target-conditioned depth mask, 0.08 m consistency, per-frame 4096 cap, registered fusion and fused 4096 cap as the predecessor
observation_carrier.color: BGR pixels at the exact retained depth-consistent target pixels before the same deterministic caps
observation_carrier.hue_descriptor: 18 bins over OpenCV Hue [0,180), plus one achromatic mass; each pixel contributes saturation/255 to its Hue bin and 1-saturation/255 to the achromatic bin; L1 normalize
observation_carrier.hue_similarity: histogram intersection; no learned or fitted weight and no similarity threshold
observation_carrier.geometry_score: unchanged negative symmetric median registered surface distance
observation_carrier.zero_assignment: compute strict reciprocal row-and-column maxima independently for geometry and Hue
observation_carrier.consensus: retain a pair only when the identical pair appears in both reciprocal match sets; no scalar score fusion

forbidden_after_freeze: change Hue bin count, achromatic formulation, similarity, reciprocity, or intersection rule
add a Hue threshold, score weight, margin, or target-specific calibration
change the RGB-D frames, masks, depth tolerance, point minimum, caps, targets, or scenarios
inspect a failed scenario and rescue it with another color space or descriptor
promote a positive result on this consumed scene to fresh confirmation
claim_boundary: This consumed-scene posthoc experiment can establish only whether a deterministic Hue-geometry reciprocal consensus is mechanically useful on the frozen SceneNN cohort. Instance masks, target geometry, poses and synchronized sensor streams remain privileged; no model is trained. It is not fresh confirmation, raw-phone perception, door detection, aperture, named entrance, ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, HANDOFF_READY, user benefit, deployment, or safety evidence.
